content.short: We are a platform for creators of existing social networks to mint their art directly from Twitter!
content.description:
Our vision is to build a decentralized social network, where users of existing social networks can mint their posts as NFTs and sell them in any marketplace they want. We want to provide the ability for every post minted to live in the blockchain and IPFS.

The process is simple: the user gives us a tweet url, they name it and they decide the amount they want to mint, and deliver them their tweet as an NFT.
